title: GUN CARD AND KEYS CHIP TIDY
why: His note of 2026-10-25 (played on 33.17, still true on 34.85): in raid, the right hand lower corner menu and the minimized controls f1 key are awkward. The gun card was at least 246 wide whatever it held, so its left half was empty, a short lime accent bar sat on its top edge and the backpack row hung at the bottom; it now hugs its rows with one padding on every side, keeps every piece of information, and keeps one size and place while he plays (each row is measured as the widest it can read with the same gun in hand: the aim word, a full magazine, a three figure reserve, RELOADING, the backpack count), so it never jumps when he fires, reloads or aims; the accent bar is gone (it was decoration, not a meter). The folded f1 controls chip floated loose on the map in a different spot in each mode; it now docks at the left end of the tactical belt on the belt caption row, in the caption style, left of key 1, in career, the demo and the second window, and F1 opens the list upward from it (his rs-1 answer kept: mid bottom left, folded). Where that spot would be beside the armour and stamina bars (a short screen with the bigger party type), the chip stands just above the vitals at the same x, so neither it nor the list ever covers them. The opened list also stands clear of the bandage, medkit and plate use bar (above where that bar shows, so it does not jump when he puts a bandage on, and higher while the ship is called), of the power up timer chips, and ends before 47 percent of the width; on a short screen it moves back left toward its old place over the vitals (where the feed leaves no such room, the demo at 1280x720, it stands right against the feed, still short of the middle).
now: The gun card in the lower right is snug around the gun name, the rounds and the backpack row, with no lime stub, and it holds still while you shoot, reload and aim. The f1 controls chip sits just left of belt key 1, on the same row as the fire use caption, and F1 opens the list above it, clear of the bandage bar, the power up timers and the health bars (on a small screen the chip stands just above the health bars and the list opens above them, left of the middle). Watch for: whether the card reads well at a glance in a fight, whether the chip is easy to find when you want F1, and whether the opened list sitting a little above the chip (it waits above where the bandage bar shows) still reads as coming from it.
